{
  description = "demo";
  inputs.nixpkgs.url = "github:NixOS/nixpkgs";
  outputs = { self, nixpkgs }:
    let
      lib = import ./lib { };
      pkgs = nixpkgs.legacyPackages.x86_64-linux;
    in {
      packages.x86_64-linux.default = pkgs.callPackage ./pkg.nix { inherit lib; };
      nixosConfigurations.box = { imports = [ ./modules/box.nix ]; };
    };
}
